Question 6
?

Water leaking onto a floor forms a circular puddle. The area of the puddle increases at a rate of 40πcm2/min. How fast is the radius of the puddle increasing at the moment when the radius is 5 cm?

a
2 cm/min
b
2π cm/min
c
4 cm/min
d
1 cm/min
e
5 cm/min
